clientPathHint: Both paths open VNC in the browser. They differ by target semantics and copy (both still TCP-proxy via the panel).
clientPathCompare: “User-reachable”: public hostnames (e.g. hermes.example.com:5901). “Server proxy”: LAN / DC targets only this host can reach. TCP is probed from this server before connect.
pathUserReachableHint: For public hostnames or targets as configured (e.g. example.com:5901). Browser goes through the panel; this host must open TCP to that address.
pathServerProxyHint: For LAN or targets only the control-plane server can reach. Traffic is proxied via this server’s network to the VNC host.
needViewerOptional: TigerVNC Viewer (optional, not for browser path)
viewerStackOptional: In-browser VNC does not need desktop vncviewer. The Viewer package below is optional system maintenance only.

viewer.clipboardHint: Sync text between this browser and the remote desktop.
viewer.clipboardLocalPh: Paste or type text to send into the VNC session
viewer.clipboardRemotePh: Text copied on the remote desktop appears here
viewer.clipboardToRemoteHint: Paste browser clipboard into the remote session
viewer.clipboardFromRemote: Remote clipboard copied to this browser
viewer.clipboardFromRemoteManual: Remote clipboard updated — open Clipboard panel to copy

viewer.clipboardReadDenied: Browser blocked clipboard read — paste into the panel and Send
viewer.clipboardNoRemote: No text received from remote yet
viewer.passwordPromptHint: This desktop requires a VNC password — enter it below.

viewer.errBusy: Too many VNC sessions on this panel — close another and retry.
viewer.errRefused: Nothing is listening on {{host}}:{{port}} (connection refused). Is VNC running and reachable from this server?
viewer.errRefusedGeneric: Connection refused — check that VNC is running and the port is correct.

viewer.errTimeoutGeneric: Connection timed out — check network and firewall.
viewer.errDnsGeneric: Host name could not be resolved.
viewer.idleHint: Session has been idle for a while. The remote desktop may lock; move the mouse or reconnect if needed.

viewer.connectingHint: Opening a secure tunnel to the desktop…

connectionAdvanced: Advanced: legacy noVNC URL & direct RFB
pathViaServerLegacyHint: Only works on the server host or via SSH tunnel — prefer “Open in browser”.
